name: Crashing Into You
source:
A heartfelt tale of forbidden love and sacrifice unfolds across the divided landscapes of modern Seoul and a rustic North Korean village, where borders are both physical and emotional.

[From [url=https://visualnovelsai.itch.io/crashing-into-you]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一段关于禁忌之恋与无私牺牲的动人故事，在现代首尔与质朴的朝鲜乡村这片分隔两地的土地上徐徐展开——横亘于此的不仅是有形的国界，更是无形的心墙。

[摘自[url=https://visualnovelsai.itch.io/crashing-into-you]itch.io[/url]]
